day4_morning_start.text: *Day 4 morning. I woke up before the alarm. 5:38 AM.*

day4_morning_start_2.text: *The writing on the wall is still there. 'Get out of here.' It wasn't a dream.*

day4_morning_start_3.text: *I traced the letters with my fingertips. Scratch marks from fingernails. Deep. Too deep to have been done in one pass.*

day4_morning_start_4.text: *...The skin under my nails is torn. It wasn't like that before I fell asleep last night.*

day4_morning_start_5.text: *Graphite and blood have dried together on the first joint of my left index finger.*

day4_morning_start_6.text: *The alarm history shows the screen turned on once at 3:12 a.m.*

day4_morning_start_7.text: *I stood in front of the mirror. ...It's fogged up again. I reached to wipe it, then stopped.*

day4_morning_start_8.text: *A shape reflects in the fogged mirror. Blurry. An outline that moves a little later than the line of my shoulders.*

day4_morning_start_9.text: *Through the steam, two pairs of eyes overlap, then merge into one again.*

day4_morning_start_10.text: *I didn't wipe it. Water on my palm falls into the sink.*

day4_morning_start_11.text: *My hand doesn't rise any higher in front of the mirror.*

day4_morning_start_12.text: *I washed my face badly. Brushed my teeth with my back to the mirror. Only the sound of the toothbrush hit the bathroom tiles.*

day4_morning_start_13.text: *My hands tremble as I put on my uniform. I fumbled the buttons three times.*

day4_morning_start_14.text: *Morning sunlight streams through the curtains. A bright day. But -- someone is standing on the sidewalk below the window. A suit. Sunglasses. Arms crossed, looking up this way.*

day4_morning_start_15.text: *Two seconds. I blinked. Only two wet footprints remain on the sidewalk.*

day4_morning_start_16.text: *Only the crease in the suit hem remains behind my eyelids. A color that doesn't belong on this neighborhood's school route.*

day4_morning_start_16_yuna.text: *Yuna's words come back to me. 'There are always the same people around this school. Not parents, not residents.'*

day4_morning_start_17.text: *I stopped at the front door. Through the gap under the door, I can see a shadow. Two feet's worth. Someone is standing right outside.*

day4_morning_start_18.text: *Five seconds. Ten seconds. I held my breath. The shadow doesn't move.*

day4_morning_start_19.text: *Fifteen seconds. The shadow disappears. There are no footsteps.*

day4_morning_start_20.text: *I open the door. The bright morning hallway is empty.*

day4_morning_start_21.text: *A white envelope lies on the floor in front of the door. No name on it.*

day4_morning_start_22.text: *I opened it. A single sheet of paper inside. Printed text: **'Today's schedule: Proceed as normal. -- Management Division'***

day4_morning_start_23.text: *Management Division? This building doesn't have one.*

day4_morning_start_24.text: *I put the envelope in my bag. My hands are shaking.*

day4_morning_commute.text: *On the way to school. A notification popped up from the safety app on my phone.*

day4_morning_commute_3.text: *Blink. Gone. When I look again, it's a student notification. 'Good morning, {name}!'*

day4_morning_commute_4.text: *I open the notification history, but the words from just now aren't there. Instead, only 'school attendance status check' is stamped at the same time.*

day4_morning_commute_4_yuna.text: *I open the notification history, but the message isn't there. The SD-card case in my bag presses against my palm.*

day4_morning_commute_5.text: *I stare at my phone again. The app icon. 'Safety App.' An app I never installed. An app that can't be deleted.*

day4_morning_commute_7.text: *The delete button is locked in gray. Small text under the app name: `institution-managed profile`.*

day4_morning_commute_8.text: *Midway through my commute. I stopped at a crosswalk. Students walking toward me from the other side. Five of them. Side by side.*

day4_morning_commute_9.text: *Students pass through the school gate. Chatter, laughter, sneakers scraping the ground. The corners of their mouths rise first, and the laughter follows half a beat late.*

day4_morning_gate.text: *School front gate. Students pass through in small groups.*

day4_morning_gate_2.text: *The boy ahead of me smiles as soon as he passes the gatepost. His face was blank a moment ago.*

day4_morning_gate_3.text: *The girl beside her smiles too. She was in the middle of another conversation, but the corners of her mouth rise first. Her eyes are still on the person she was talking to.*

day4_morning_gate_4.text: *Another student frowns at his phone outside the wall. One step through the gate, and only the corners of his mouth rise.*

day4_morning_gate_5.text: *That's the third one. The moment they step on the shadow inside the gate, their expression changes.*

day4_morning_gate_6.text: *Three girls pass through the gate. Only one turns to look at me, smiling. The other two keep talking.*

day4_morning_gate_7.text: *The red operation light under the front gate speaker is on. It doesn't go out.*

day4_morning_gate_8.text: *The moment my eyes reach the speaker's indicator light, a gaze slides toward me, then disappears.*

day4_morning_gate_9.text: *Ms. Eunsu stands before the front gate, leaning against it with a smile, directly beneath the speaker's indicator light.*

day4_morning_gate_10.text: *The second hand on Eunsu's watch moves in the same rhythm as the static from the front gate speaker.*

day4_morning_eunsu_2.text: Let's walk to the classroom together today.

day4_morning_eunsu_3.text: *She folds her arms and stands beside me.*

day4_morning_eunsu_comply.text: *I walk beside Ms. Eunsu all the way to the classroom. The toe of her shoe keeps touching the edge of my shadow.*

day4_morning_eunsu_refuse.text: It's fine. I'll go on ahead.

day4_morning_eunsu_refuse_4.text: *Danger. At the end of the word, Eunsu's smile stopped for the briefest instant.*

day4_morning_eunsu_refuse_5.text: *Ms. Eunsu follows half a step behind {name}. The toes of her shoes keep catching on the edge of {name}'s shadow.*

day4_morning_classroom_met.text: ***Yuna's seat. Empty. No bag. No trace of her at all.***

day4_morning_classroom_met_2.text: *Only wipe marks remain on the desk. Not a single doodle. Its surface is a shade lighter than the others.*

day4_morning_classroom_met_3.text: *There were stickers there yesterday. Photography-club stickers. They're gone too.*

day4_morning_classroom_met_4.text: Sea, where did Yuna go? Her seat is empty.

day4_morning_classroom_notmet.text: *An empty seat catches my eye. Every other desk bears scratches or stickers, but that one is spotless.*

day4_morning_classroom_notmet_2.text: *I try to picture the seating chart, but only that spot stays blank white. I can remember the names for the other seats.*

day4_morning_classroom_notmet_4.text: *Sea says it like it's nothing. Only the aisle beside the empty seat is strangely wide. No one puts their bag down over there.*

day4_morning_sea.text: Yuna? ...She transferred. Back to her old school.

day4_morning_sea_3a.text: It was posted in the group chat last night. Didn't you see it?

day4_morning_sea_3a_react.text: *I open the group chat. There are no announcements from last night. The last message is a photo of the lunch menu.*

day4_morning_sea_4.text: *My fingertips touch the SD card case inside my bag. It's exactly as Yuna handed it to me yesterday.*

day4_morning_sea_5.text: You know Yuna Choi, right? The photography club junior.

day4_morning_sea_6.text: Choi Yuna? Was there someone by that name?

day4_morning_sea_7.text: Yuna...? Oh, maybe the one who transferred last year?

day4_morning_sea_8.text: *Last year? Yuna was here until yesterday.*

day4_morning_sea_9.text: *The corner of the desk where the photography club sticker used to be is a little less faded.*

day4_morning_sea_10.text: *Only the sticker was peeled off, but even the dust mark is gone with it.*

day4_morning_class_2.text: *Eunsu stands at the lectern. Picks up the chalk. Writes 'Belonging' on the blackboard.*

day4_morning_class_3.text: *The attendance book lies open on the lectern. One field in the middle is blank, with traces of correction tape.*

day4_morning_class_3_met.text: *The attendance book lies open on the lectern. The field where Yuna's name should be is blank, with traces of correction tape.*

day4_morning_class_4.text: When a name is on the attendance book, teachers don't let that student slip away.

day4_morning_class_5.text: If they're absent, we call. If they're lost, we go get them.

day4_morning_class_6.text: Leaving the roster... would be a problem.

day4_morning_class_7.text: *Her gaze locks onto {name}. She takes one step closer from the lectern.*

day4_morning_class_10.text: *Every pair of eyes in the classroom turns toward me. Thirty pairs. All smiling.*

day4_morning_class_11.text: *One side is empty. That clean seat I saw earlier. The smell of correction tape reaches all the way to the front desk.*

day4_morning_class_11_met.text: *Twenty-nine pairs of eyes. Only Yuna's seat is empty. Sunlight lies in a square on the vacant desk.*

day4_morning_end.text: *Morning classes ended. My shirt's top button presses against my throat.*
